tools.name: search_machines
tools.description: Find CPAP, APAP, BiPAP and travel machines on CPAPMachine.ai by brand, model or type. Returns name, brand, type, status (current, discontinued, recalled), release year, summary and page link. No prices.

tools.name: get_machine
tools.description: One machine's page data: specs as the site states them, features, strengths and trade offs (spec facts), patient menu comfort settings, setup, cleaning, troubleshooting, replacement parts, travel, recall or safety status, and sources. Never covers prescribed pressure or clinician settings.

tools.name: lookup_error_code
tools.description: What an error code or alarm message means on a CPAP machine, what the user can safely check, and when to contact the equipment supplier or manufacturer. Name the machine for the best match; without it every machine is searched.

tools.name: search_help
tools.description: Search CPAPMachine.ai troubleshooting pages (leaks, dry mouth, aerophagia), mask and mask type pages, and guides (cleaning, travel, insurance, sleep data). Pass kind and slug from a result to get the full page: causes, fixes, when to call your doctor, fitting and cleaning steps, sources.

tools.name: get_safety_notices
tools.description: Recalls and safety warnings CPAPMachine.ai covers, quoted with the dates their sources give: recalled machines, masks with magnets and safety guides such as ozone and UV cleaners. Filter with a machine, mask or brand name.
